tagline: 美能达微型相机，1970 年发布
description: 美能达于1970年推出的微型相机。配备fixed-focus Rokkor 1:2.8/23mm with 4 elements in 3 groups, a sliding door with an additional close-up element can be shifted into the position in front of the lens。快门速度Speeds set manually between 1/30 and 1/500 sec.; X sync at all speeds。使用Minolta 16mm film with speeds 25 to 400 ASA。

specs.胶片/画幅: Minolta 16mm film with speeds 25 to 400 ASA
specs.镜头: fixed-focus Rokkor 1:2.8/23mm with 4 elements in 3 groups, a sliding door with an additional close-up element can be shifted into the position in front of the lens
specs.快门: Speeds set manually between 1/30 and 1/500 sec.; X sync at all speeds
specs.光圈: set manually between 1:2.8 and 1:16, or fully automatically, controlled by a CdS meter close to the lens (EV 8–17)
specs.取景器: optical bright frame finder with parallax marks and control flags for low light and for close-up setting
specs.英文简介: The Minolta-16 MG-S was the flagship of Minolta's subminiature camera series, and the penultimate Minolta 16.
